findings.title: Bind drafts to the provider while routed provider discovery is pending
findings.detail: Catalog-source changes launch sdk.providers.list asynchronously while the old provider remains displayed. All models remains editable. If the routed result excludes that provider, setProviderId selects the first different provider. Because dirty is true, the draft synchronization effect returns early and retains the old provider's rule. Apply then saves that retained rule under the new provider ID. The server accepts All mode without catalog validation, so this can persist the wrong provider configuration.
findings.reproduction: Start with provider custom selected[a]. Change Machine to host-new and defer providers.list. Click All models while custom is still shown. Resolve the list to only other-provider, then Apply. The real component calls saveProvider with providerId other-provider and rule {mode:all,modelIds:[a]}.

evidence.target_test: never applies a draft to a different provider after async routed discovery
evidence.result: Failed: observed wrong-provider save; other copied tests skipped in this targeted run.

findings.remedy: Keep an explicit provider identity for drafts or prevent editing/submitting until routed provider discovery settles. An automatic provider change must load the newly selected provider's saved rule and must not silently transfer a dirty draft.
findings.legitimate_flow_to_preserve: After routed discovery completes, the user must still configure the selected provider, and All/reset must remain usable without successful model-catalog discovery.
